name: Forbidden Memories
source:
Amidst the mundane rhythm of office life, our MC embarks on a journey of self-discovery, aided by an invention, handcrafted for him by his best friend. With each step you take new opportunities present itself, often leading to unexpected revelations or unforeseen consequences. From the bland interior of a boardroom to the extraordinary sexual nightclub, every encounter matters. Join our MC as he navigates the treacherous waters of loyalty and betrayal, in a world where nothing is as it seems, the journey awaits with themes of loyalty, betrayal, romance, love, lust, deception and much more!

[From [url=https://sgdp27.itch.io/forbidden-memories]itch.io[/url].]
translation:
在办公室生活的平凡节奏中，我们的主持人在他最好的朋友为他手工制作的一项发明的帮助下，踏上了自我发现的旅程。每迈出一步，新的机会就会出现，往往会带来意想不到的启示或不可预见的后果。从平淡的会议室内部到非凡的性夜总会，每一次相遇都很重要。和我们的主持人一起航行在忠诚和背叛的危险水域中，在一个一切都不是表面上的世界中，旅程的主题是忠诚、背叛、浪漫、爱情、欲望、欺骗等等！

[来自[url=https://sgdp27.itch.io/forbidden-memories]itch.io[/url]。]
